page_title: EIN 2-0 PAU | Eintracht Frankfurt v St. Pauli 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' The attendance is 59500.
89' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
86' Substitution. Karol Mets makes way for Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli).
86' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Fares Chaibi is replaced by Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt).
86' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ritsu Doan.

84' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
82' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Now St. Pauli have a corner.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch so that Jonathan Burkardt can be given a rest.

78' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
77' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
76' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Nikola Vasilj comes off the line to clear the ball away.
74' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) sends a long ball in, but Michael Zetterer comfortably gathers the ball.
71' Substitution. Ansgar Knauff makes his way off the pitch and Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as his replacement.
71' Here is a change. Can Yilmaz Uzun is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
70' Substitution. Martijn Kaars will be replaced by Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli).
69' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) sends a long ball in, but Michael Zetterer comfortably gathers the ball.
69' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to St. Pauli.
68' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
68' The percentage of ball possession is – 60:40.
66' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nikola Vasilj, who smothers the ball.

64' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Robin Braun stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a free kick to St. Pauli, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
61' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Andreas Hountondji will be replaced by Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
61' The substitution has been made. Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) has replaced Mathias Pereira Lage.

60' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
58' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
56' 2 - 0 Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) scores a goal! He latched on to a precise cross inside the box and beat the keeper with a shot to the middle of the goal.

55' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Robin Braun blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt in a dangerous position.
54' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. St. Pauli are awarded a free kick.
48' A clumsy foul by Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Robin Braun blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to St. Pauli.

47' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Nikola Vasilj is alert and denies him.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Robin Braun blows his whistle and signals a foul after Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) brought his opponent down.
43' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
41' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
38' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is out of play. St. Pauli will take a throw-in.
38' Poor challenge! Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is penalised for tripping and Robin Braun blows his whistle. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a free kick near the side line.
37' The booking goes to Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli).
36' 1 - 0 Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the left post, and thus alter the score to 1:0.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.
32' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
31' The game is interrupted as Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is flagged offside.
28' Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul after Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) hacks down one of his opponents. St. Pauli get a free kick.
24' The linesman signals that Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

23' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Robin Braun blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to St. Pauli.

21' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Danel Sinani (St. Pauli), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
21' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
20' The Eintracht Frankfurt players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
17' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) sends a long ball in, but Michael Zetterer comfortably gathers the ball.
14' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a long ball in, but Nikola Vasilj comfortably gathers the ball.
12' Great teamplay by St. Pauli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

8' He should have scored! Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Good work from Eintracht Frankfurt as they win a corner.
6' Eintracht Frankfurt enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
4' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
2' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
St. Pauli will kick the game off.
Robin Braun will supervise the game today.
